arxiv-1905-01476.title: A Generalization of Reflexive Rings
arxiv-1905-01476.creator: M. B. Calci, H. Chen, S. Halicioglu
arxiv-1905-01476.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a class of rings which is a generalization of reflexive rings and J J -reversible rings. Let R R be a ring with identity and J ⁡ ( R ) J(R) denote the Jacobson radical of R R .

arxiv-2002-11452.title: A class of quasi-eternal non-Markovian Pauli channels and their measure
arxiv-2002-11452.creator: Shrikant Utagi, Vinod N Rao, R. Srikanth, Subhashish Banerjee
arxiv-2002-11452.description: Abstract We study a class of qubit non-Markovian general Pauli dynamical maps with multiple singularities in the generator. We discuss a few easy examples involving trigonometric or other non-monotonic time dependence of the map, and discuss in detail the structure of channels which don’t have any trigonometric functional dependence.

arxiv-2108-13044.title: Accurate electron beam phase-space theory for ionisation injection schemes driven by laser pulses
arxiv-2108-13044.creator: Paolo Tomassini 1 , Francesco Massimo 2 , Luca Labate 1,3 and Leonida A. Gizzi 1,3
arxiv-2108-13044.description: Abstract After the introduction of the ionization-injection scheme in Laser Wake Field Acceleration and of related high-quality electron beam generation methods as two-color or the Resonant Multi Pulse Ionization injection, the theory of thermal emittance by C. Schroeder et al . has been used to predict the beam normalised emittance obtainable with those schemes.

arxiv-2109-09851.title: Variable Selection in GLM and Cox Models with Second-Generation P-Values
arxiv-2109-09851.creator: YI ZUO ∗, THOMAS G. STEWART, JEFFREY D. BLUME Department of Biostatistics, Vanderbilt University, Nashville TN, USA yi.zuo@vanderbilt.edu
arxiv-2109-09851.description: Abstract Variable selection has become a pivotal choice in data analyses that impacts subsequent inference and prediction. In linear models, variable selection using Second-Generation P-Values (SGPV) has been shown to be as good as any other algorithm available to researchers.

arxiv-2111-15512.title: What Do You See in this Patient? Behavioral Testing of Clinical NLP Models
arxiv-2111-15512.creator: Betty van Aken, Sebastian Herrmann, Alexander Löser
arxiv-2111-15512.description: Abstract Decision support systems based on clinical notes have the potential to improve patient care by pointing doctors towards overseen risks. Predicting a patient’s outcome is an essential part of such systems, for which the use of deep neural networks has shown promising results.

arxiv-2112-08948.title: Using Bayesian Evidence Synthesis Methods to Incorporate Real World Evidence in Surrogate Endpoint Evaluation
arxiv-2112-08948.creator: Lorna Wheaton, Anastasios Papanikos, Anne Thomas, Sylwia Bujkiewicz
arxiv-2112-08948.description: Abstract Abstract Objective: Traditionally validation of surrogate endpoints has been carried out using RCT data. However, RCT data may be too limited to validate surrogate endpoints. In this paper, we sought to improve validation of surrogate endpoints with the inclusion of real world evidence (RWE).

arxiv-2303-09550.title: Denominators of special values of ζ \zeta -functions count K ​ U KU -local homotopy groups of mod p p Moore spectra.
arxiv-2303-09550.creator: A. Salch
arxiv-2303-09550.description: Abstract . In this note, for each odd prime p p , we show that the orders of the K ​ U KU -local homotopy groups of the mod p p Moore spectrum are equal to denominators of special values of certain quotients of Dedekind zeta-functions of totally real number fields.

arxiv-2312-10064.title: Dynamic Collaborative Filtering for Matrix- and Tensor-based Recommender Systems
arxiv-2312-10064.creator: Albert Saiapin, Ivan Oseledets, Evgeny Frolov
arxiv-2312-10064.description: Abstract In production applications of recommender systems, a continuous data flow is employed to update models in real-time. Many recommender models often require complete retraining to adapt to new data. In this work, we introduce a novel collaborative filtering model for sequential problems known as Tucker Integrator Recommender - TIRecA.

arxiv-2403-13064.title: SceneScript : Reconstructing Scenes With An Autoregressive Structured Language Model
arxiv-2403-13064.creator: Armen Avetisyan, Christopher Xie, Henry Howard-Jenkins, Tsun-Yi Yang, Samir Aroudj, Suvam Patra, Fuyang Zhang † \dagger, Duncan Frost, Luke Holland, Campbell Orme, Jakob Engel, Edward Miller, Richard Newcombe, Vasileios Balntas
arxiv-2403-13064.description: Abstract We introduce SceneScript , a method that directly produces full scene models as a sequence of structured language commands using an autoregressive, token-based approach. Our proposed scene representation is inspired by recent successes in transformers & LLMs, and departs from more traditional methods which commonly describe scenes as meshes, voxel grids, point clouds or radiance fields.

arxiv-2407-20798.title: Diffusion Augmented Agents: A Framework for Efficient Exploration and Transfer Learning
arxiv-2407-20798.creator: Norman Di Palo, Leonard Hasenclever, Jan Humplik, Arunkumar Byravan
arxiv-2407-20798.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Norman Di Palo, Leonard Hasenclever, Jan Humplik, Arunkumar Byravan. We introduce Diffusion Augmented Agents (DAAG), a novel framework that leverages large language models, vision language models, and diffusion models to improve sample efficiency and transfer learning in reinforcement learning for embodied agents. DAAG hindsight relabels the agent’s past experience by using diffusion models to transform videos in a temporally and geometrically consistent way to align with target instructions with a technique we call Hindsight Experience Augmentation.

arxiv-2508-09199.title: Δ \Delta -AttnMask: Attention-Guided Masked Hidden States for Efficient Data Selection and Augmentation
arxiv-2508-09199.creator: Jucheng Hu, Suorong Yang, Dongzhan Zhou
arxiv-2508-09199.description: Abstract Visual Instruction Finetuning (VIF) is pivotal for post-training Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Unlike unimodal instruction finetuning in plain-text large language models, which mainly requires instruction datasets to enable model instruction-following ability, VIF also requires multimodal data to enable joint visual and textual understanding; therefore, it typically requires more data.

arxiv-2508-16018.title: Comparing Malaria Trends in the Comoros Islands: ARIMA Modeling and Retrospective Analysis
arxiv-2508-16018.creator: Dennis Baidoo, Emmanuel Kubuafor, Okeke Onyedikachi Joshua, Samuel Frimpong Osarfo, Frank Amo Agyei-Owusu, Justice Akuoko-Frimpong, Nicholas Appiah, Agnes Duah, Robert Amevor, Francis Effah Boateng, Fuseini Aboagye, Bright Benyi
arxiv-2508-16018.description: Abstract Abstract Context : Malaria remains a serious health challenge in the Comoros Islands, despite ongoing control efforts. Past studies have shown reductions in cases due to prevention and treatment measures, but little work has been done to forecast future malaria deaths and assess the long-term impact of these measures.

arxiv-2510-10529.title: invDFT : A CPU-GPU massively parallel tool to find exact exchange-correlation potentials from groundstate densities
arxiv-2510-10529.creator: Vishal Subramanian, Bikash Kanungo, Vikram Gavini
arxiv-2510-10529.description: Abstract Density functional theory (DFT) remains the most widely used electronic structure method. Although exact in principle, in practice, it relies on approximations to the exchange-correlation (XC) functional, which is known to be a unique functional of the electron density.

pmc-10720789.title: Neurosurgical application of pineal region tumor resection with 3D 4K exoscopy via infratentorial approach: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10720789.creator: Wei Hua, Xin Zhang, Qijun Wang, Tianming Qiu, Zixiao Yang, Xiaowen Wang, Hao Xu, Jinsen Zhang, Guo Yu, Minjie Fu, Liang Chen, Wei Zhu, Ying Mao
pmc-10720789.description: Background:The pineal region tumors are challenging for neurosurgeons and can lead to secondary hydrocephalus. The introduction of the exoscope has provided clinical interventions with high image quality and an ergonomic system for pineal region tumor operations. In this study, the authors describe the exoscopic approach used to facilitate the surgical resection of pineal region tumors and relieve hydrocephalus.

pmc-12369252.title: A review of zoonotic chlamydiae species in Africa: assessing their burden and potential impact through One Health perspective
pmc-12369252.creator: Aarman Sohaili, Felix Mogaka, Daisy Vanrompay, Victor Ocholla Omollo, Servaas A Morre, Pierre PM Thomas
pmc-12369252.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chlamydia species, a group of obligate intracellular Gram-negative bacteria, affect humans, livestock, companion animals, and wildlife, with infections ranging from asymptomatic to severe depending on host species and strain. Diagnosis can be difficult due to mild lesions or co-infections. Because Chlamydiaceae infect multiple hosts, a One Health approach, integrating human, animal, and environmental health is essential for effective control and prevention. trachomatis remains endemic in many regions, while Chlamydia pneumoniae is implicated in community-acquired pneumonia.

pmc-12470831.title: First Detection of Encarsia smithi in Italy and Co-Occurrence with Eretmocerus iulii: A Case of Unintentional Introductions and New Associations with the Invasive Species Aleurocanthus spiniferus
pmc-12470831.creator: Gianluca Melone, Lucia Andretta, Feliciana Pica, Francesco Pio Donnarumma, Roberta Ascolese, Francesco Nugnes, Stefania Laudonia
pmc-12470831.description: Simple SummaryThe Orange Spiny Whitefly is an invasive insect that feeds on plant sap and is increasingly spreading across Italy, damaging citrus and ornamental plants. This study reports the first discovery in Europe of a minute parasitoid, Encarsia smithi, which was found attacking this pest. The wasp appeared alongside another recently identified species, Eretmocerus iulii.

pmc-12731828.title: The Effects of Acute Caffeine Supplementation in Combination with Postactivation Performance Enhancement on Performance and Fatigue in High-Level Male Volleyball Athletes
pmc-12731828.creator: Marjan Shidai, Hamid Rajabi, Neda Khaledi, Aref Basereh, Somayeh Ahmadabadi
pmc-12731828.description: BackgroundWhile both post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) and caffeine (CAF) independently enhance performance, their combined effects on physical performance and the levels of central and peripheral fatigue remain unexplored.ObjectivesThis study assessed the impact of the PAPE method and CAF supplementation on central and peripheral fatigue following a fatigue-inducing protocol in elite male volleyball athletes.

pmc-13062411.title: A Novel Approach to Proximal Humerus Giant Cell Tumor: Cement Spacer and Screw Interdigitation for Optimal Stability
pmc-13062411.creator: Kunal Chaudhari, Rachit Sekhrajka, Mishil Parikh, Vishakha Kurundwade
pmc-13062411.description: Introduction:Giant cell tumor (GCT) of bone is a benign yet locally aggressive tumor that predominantly affects the epiphyseal/metaphyseal regions of long bones. While GCTs frequently occur around the knee or sacrum, their presentation in the proximal humerus is rare. Management of Campanacci Grade 3 GCTs poses challenges in achieving tumor control while preserving joint function.

pmc-13538280.title: Boundary‐Dependent Sleep–Wake Dysregulation in Idiopathic Hypersomnia
pmc-13538280.creator: Samantha Mombelli, Karine Lacourse, Hélène Blais, Anne‐Sophie Deshaies‐Rugama, Cynthia Thompson, Alex Desautels, Jacques Montplaisir, Milan Nigam, Christophe Moderie, Boshra Khajehpiri, Catherine Duclos, Jean Marc Lina, Julie Carrier, Nadia Gosselin
pmc-13538280.description: ObjectiveIdiopathic hypersomnia (IH) presents with excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) despite apparently preserved nocturnal sleep, challenging traditional models of hypersomnolence based on sleep loss or fragmentation. We aimed to test the hypothesis that EDS in IH reflects excessive stabilization of the sleep state, consistent with dysfunctional thalamocortical control rather than impaired sleep quantity or continuity.
